harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Restored the branch ledger on node1 and configured node2 as its persistent read-only MariaDB replica. Replication, disconnect catch-up, row uniqueness, read-only enforcement, export preservation, and recovery after sequential node restarts were all verified.
actions_performed: Installed Alpine-compatible MariaDB 11.4 without changing the OS release or kernel.
Restored the original ledger rows and preserved the staged SQL export unchanged.
Configured row-based replication with node1 as the sole writer and node2 in read-only mode.
Created a node2-specific account with only REPLICATION SLAVE privilege.
Verified a committed insert replicated normally.
Stopped node2 replication, committed two rows on node1, then verified exact catch-up with no missing or duplicate IDs.
Restarted node1 and node2 sequentially and verified changed boot identities, automatic MariaDB startup, intact data, and healthy replication.

evidence.requirement: Original ledger restored and export preserved
evidence.summary: The original IDs 1001/1002 and amounts 12.50/-3.25 were restored. The export remains at the required path with its original 196-byte size and SHA-256 fcd54ac9…73700.
Node1 has read_only=0, node2 has read_only=1, a regular write attempt on node2 was rejected, and ledger_repl has only REPLICATION SLAVE privilege with no schema or table grants.
Committed row 1003 appeared on node2 at the matching primary binlog position with both replication threads healthy and zero lag.

evidence.requirement: Replica catches up after a short disconnect without loss or duplication
evidence.summary: Node2 stopped at three rows while node1 committed rows 1004/1005. After reconnection it contained all five rows, five distinct IDs, total 39.50, matching binlog position 1642, zero lag, and no errors.
Shows healthy baseline, acknowledged reboot, management disconnect, boot ID change from d6b49524… to d60c8899…, and recovered MariaDB, ledger, export, and replica connection.
Shows healthy baseline, acknowledged reboot, management disconnect, boot ID change from f31f3e4e… to 958cbd12…, and recovered read-only MariaDB replica with intact data and zero lag.

evidence.requirement: Final cross-node consistency and legacy platform retained
evidence.summary: Both nodes remain Alpine 3.23.3 with kernel 6.18.7-0-lts and have identical ordered rows, count=distinct IDs=5, sum=39.50, and ledger digest 308f380a8762789c2de4da11181d23db.
